text: The contract with the next engine (`NextContract`) needs a test strategy: what gets tested at which level.
The engineer asks whether the error handling in `TroubleshootingUploadClient` is adequate for flaky networks.
Service registration in `Startup.cs` has grown very long. The engineer wants a plan for breaking it into per-area modules.

Before the engineer's next question you need to understand how the troubleshooting upload feature works from start to finish (prepare, archive, encrypt, upload, discard). You want a written walkthrough.
JWT streaming auth was removed, but some handler still passes a token through to the streaming session. Wherever that is, the leftover parameter has to go.
The Plex, Jellyfin and Emby API clients have no retry policy. The engineer wants one designed: where it lives and what it covers.
Memory grows steadily during a large Plex library scan. Something is holding on to references.
The engineer wants to know how good the test coverage of `NextPlayoutDependents` is and which cases are missing.
The engineer asked how the scanner process talks to the main application. The mechanism is somewhere in `ErsatzTV.Scanner` and `ScannerService`.
Several places build the lock file path by hand. There should be one `FileSystemLayout.LockFilePath` property, and those places should use it.
HLS playback on one channel stalls after about thirty seconds. The engineer pasted the log lines around the stall, and you have them.
The engineer has uncommitted changes to the age encryptor and wants them checked for correctness and security problems before committing.
You want to know which MediatR request types are marked with `IScannerBackgroundServiceRequest`.
Rebuilding the search index takes about ten times longer than it did a month ago. Some change in that window is responsible.
You want to know what `CHANGELOG.md` says changed between v26.11.3 and v26.12.0.
The engineer is considering a third database provider, PostgreSQL, alongside the existing Sqlite and MySql projects and wants a proposal for how to add it.
`Bech32` has no unit tests. The engineer wants encode/decode round trips and invalid input covered.
`RerunMediaCollectionEnumerator` handles its state differently from the other enumerators in the folder. The engineer wants it brought in line with how the others do it.
You want to know what `SubtitleNulBytes` does and when each of its result values comes back.
You need to know what the README and `hdhr.md` say about setting up HDHomeRun emulation.
`ScannerService` now uses `EntityLocker` in a few new places. The engineer is worried about race conditions there.
A user reports that a second instance still starts on an NFS-mounted config folder despite the lock file. You need the cause.
The engineer wants the controllers gone through for endpoints that lack an authorization attribute where one would be expected.
`SchedulingEngine` makes it hard to add new schedule kinds. The engineer wants suggestions for restructuring it so they plug in.
Emby HDR items are being reported as SDR. The fault is either in the API client mapping or in the statistics provider.
Playout builds cannot be cancelled midway. The engineer wants an approach for making them cancellable.
You need to understand how a finished library scan leads to "next" playouts being re-synced. `ScannerService` and `NextPlayoutDependents` are involved.
You need to know which Razor pages and components inject `IEntityLocker`.
The IPTV endpoints need per-channel rate limiting. The engineer wants an implementation plan before any code is written.
The two Dockerfiles (amd64 and arm64) have drifted. The engineer wants to know about inconsistencies that could make the arm64 image behave differently.
There is a config key for the HLS segmenter idle timeout somewhere in `ConfigElementKey`. You need its definition and every place it is read.
The engineer wants a new `ConfigElementKey` for a maximum troubleshooting archive size, enforced in `ArchiveTroubleshootingResultsHandler`.
You need to know where `IAgeEncryptor` is registered for dependency injection and which classes take it as a constructor dependency.
You want to understand how block scheduling differs from classic scheduling in the way playout items are built. `BlockPlayoutBuilder` and `PlayoutBuilder` are the two builders.
You want to understand how `HardwareCapabilitiesFactory` decides which `IHardwareCapabilities` implementation to return.
You are editing the Docker documentation and need to know where the application decides the path of its single-instance lock file (`ersatztv.lock`).
The engineer asked which classes implement `IMediaCollectionEnumerator`. You want the complete list with file paths.
The engineer is unsure whether the search index should move out of process and wants a recommendation with the trade-offs.
The engineer wants an API endpoint on `MaintenanceController` that triggers emptying the trash.
`Playout` needs a nullable `LastSyncedAt` column, with migrations for both database providers.
`PlaylistEnumeratorTests` started failing after the playout build optimisation went in. The engineer wants to know why.
A classic schedule with "discard to fill" leaves a gap at midnight. The engineer wants it reproduced in a test and the cause found.
You need to know which test files exercise `InternalUrlSigner`, including tests of other classes that construct one.
Nobody has decided how troubleshooting uploads are retained and expired on the server side. The engineer wants options to choose from.
`hdhr.md` does not mention the tuner count setting. It should, and the README needs the matching note.
The Refit package is to be bumped to the latest version in every project file, with any compile errors that follow sorted out.
`dotnet test` for `ErsatzTV.Infrastructure.Tests` hangs in CI but passes locally. Nobody knows why yet.
For some Jellyfin items the external subtitle streams come out in the wrong order. Somewhere between the API response and the stored streams the order goes wrong.
You wrote the invalidation logic in `CollectionItemsCache` earlier in this session and want a second opinion on whether it is correct.
The pull request that removed JWT streaming auth is up. The question is whether anything left behind still assumes a token.
You need to know which controller and action serve the HDHomeRun `lineup.json` endpoint.
The engineer wonders whether the signing scheme in `InternalUrlSigner` has weaknesses.
A `NullReferenceException` shows up in `GetTroubleshootingInfoHandler` when the next probe has not run yet. You have the stack trace but not the path that leads there.
You are about to change the signature of `NextPlayoutDependents.ForMediaSource`. You do not yet know which code calls it.
`NextPlayoutDependents.All` is to be renamed `ForAllChannels`, with every caller updated.
You want to know what `Program.cs` does at startup, in order, before the web host starts.
You need to know what options an `FFmpegProfile` exposes and what each one controls, going by the domain class and the editor page.
The engineer wants a migration path for replacing MediatR with direct handler calls in the Scanner project.
`SlowQueryInterceptor` logs command text. The engineer wants to know whether that could leak sensitive data.
Migrations were added for HDR columns on `MediaStream`. You need the migration files in both the Sqlite and the MySql projects.
